steps.step: M2.R1 repair: with a reference pair (eta, zeta) the Gamma_a = i gamma_a eta satisfy Cl(4) with unchanged even bilinears; an isometry V onto a fixed-total-parity sector intertwines Gamma_a V = V gamma_a; the even mass i beta eta restricts EXACTLY to beta (all walk spectra transfer); the mass pulse changes total parity with probability 0

steps.step: M3.price of R1: V^dag n_ref V = (1 +- chi)/2, so a reference splitting adds the chiral potential (Delta/2) chi; alpha.k + m beta + mu chi has E^2 = m^2 + (|k| +- mu)^2 (Lorentz only for mu = 0); a frozen reference kills the mass (P beta P = 0): R1 needs an exactly degenerate reference pair

M4.mass classes: every uniform anticommuting mass pulse (single or symmetric) leaves U(+-P)^2 = I with spectrum {1,1,-1,-1}; a uniform chiral phase e^{-i pi/4 chi} frees P but has two exact zero quasi-energies at (pi/4,0,0); AX.SHEETMASS (C(x) = exp(-(i/2)(m + m_s s(x)) beta), U = C W C) passes the JOINT test at (m, m_s) = (0.2, 0.6): gaps at 0 and pi, isotropic Dirac limit, exponential clustering
steps.detail: gaps 0.200 (0), 0.200 (pi); m_eff = 0.2000; anisotropy of omega^2 - k^2 relative to m_eff^2: 1.5e-03 -> 3.8e-04; |<psi^dag psi>| at r = 1,3,5: [0.35 0.01 0.  ], rate 1.52
